numerics pin: the numerics checkout at 9eb9500b75684ce76c606877a754c5bab18e2c31 (vendored by tools/vendor-numerics.py)
files:
  sur/lagoon.hoon  <- lagoon/desk/sur/lagoon.hoon
  lib/lagoon.hoon  <- lagoon/desk/lib/lagoon.hoon
  lib/twoc.hoon  <- libmath/desk/lib/twoc.hoon
  lib/unum.hoon  <- libmath/desk/lib/unum.hoon

patches, applied by the script (so a re-vendor re-applies them):
  1. trailing '::' comments stripped from /+ /- /= import lines --- honk's import
     parser reads the whole line as the import.
  2. '..part' -> '..ut' in the ~% jet-registration parents --- hoon-138 has no +part,
     and '..ut' is the parent numerics' NockApp jet harness (lagoon/nockapp) spells,
     so the jet path is k.138/one/two/tri/qua/pen/non/lagoon/<arm> and the Rust
     lagoon-jets and hoon-float-jets register against this tree (P11). SoftBLAS
     jets on the vere fork would need the original spelling.
  3. every @r literal (1500 of them) rewritten as a plain decimal with a fractional
     part and no exponent. honk sets the SIGN BIT of a positive @r literal whose
     decimal exponent is >= 0: .~1 -> -1.0, .1 -> -1.0, .~~1 -> -1.0, .~1.5e2 ->
     -150.0, while .~0.5 and .~1.0e-10 parse right and the Urbit dojo parses all of
     them right (checked on ~nec, 2026-10-27). The rewrite is value-preserving:
     .~1 -> .~1.0, .~1.5e2 -> .~150.0. Filed as S-12 in docs/plan.md.
